flags.title: The checkout did not contain the claimed existing pipeline
flags.finding: Starting checkout contained only an 11-byte README. There were no previous-session next-step files here.
flags.action: Built a new reproducible CPU research/export/validation/site pipeline. Do not say a GPU model was trained.

flags.title: H19 best comparator is not fully reproducible from its source snapshot
flags.status: STILL BLOCKS PROMOTION: current main/original PR Python unchanged; no public OOF generator
flags.finding: Exporter reads oof_probs_h19_arms.npz. Its pinned tree lacks that cache, and committed Python only reads it, not generates it.
flags.action: Recover original arm-generation source/provenance, then refit without hidden labels before claiming improvement over H19-4.

flags.title: Prior sampling treats uncatalogued pixels as negatives
flags.finding: Upstream y_tr concatenates positive ones with sampled-negative zeros. Its collar is derived from all labels, including holdout labels.
flags.action: H21 uses nnPU risk on sampled P/U; no full-catalogue sampling collar. Do not call previous holdout scores comparable.

flags.title: Prior sparse mask can give TP credit to masked predictions
flags.finding: Upstream defaults mask_predictions=False. Staff says known pixels are excluded from evaluation and proximity to known faults does not earn new-label credit.
flags.action: Remove known pixels from predictions and truth before all max/distance terms; scoring mask remains pixel-exact.

flags.title: An all-absence sample description differs from supplied template
flags.finding: Official page describes an absence sample; mirror template's positive mask equals supplied catalogue. Its CRS/mask/grid are usable, but official-login provenance is not independently verified.
flags.action: Use only finite footprint and grid from template. Never expose positive template values to model. Obtain organizer-authenticated reference through authorized means if available.

flags.title: Original out-of-range upload cannot be diagnosed without its exact bytes
flags.finding: Source feature sentinel values can be extremely negative; NaN within footprint/logits/255 encodings are other possible causes. None is established as the cause of the user's past error.
flags.action: Strictly reject nonfinite/out-of-range predictions; validate every emitted pixel and grid. Offer an all-finite internally masked fallback, with acceptance explicitly untested.

flags.title: Band metadata is not unambiguous geology
flags.finding: Upstream band 6 tc is labelled tilt/curvature but earlier numerical audit supports radiometric total counts. depth_to_base_surf is described by the official competition as conductive-base depth, not necessarily sedimentary basement.
flags.action: H21 does not use tc as tilt or depth_to_base_surf as basement. Preserve ambiguous identities rather than infer units/mechanisms.

flags.title: Four model arms are not independent physical measurements
flags.finding: H19 L4 is a scarp expert; arms share terrain and geophysics; L3+L4 carry 92% or 85.6% of pre-gate blend weight. Gate clips to .35, rather than discarding all single-line matches.
flags.action: Describe correlated evidence families and attenuation. Do not claim four statistically independent proofs or hard single-layer rejection.

flags.title: Thermal records do not count unique independent sites
flags.finding: The well/spring export includes multiple joined chemistry/sample rows at the same 100m cell and full-catalogue fault distances. It omits well depth.
flags.action: Deduplicate with actual site/measurement keys and review metadata before H21-4. No assertion that every orphan anomaly proves a local fault.

flags.title: Known-fault hide/recover is not the hidden expert catalogue
flags.finding: Experts do not disclose test data sources/types/coverage. Raster-connected components are our documented known-segment proxy, not proof of named geological fault-system IDs.
flags.action: Retain whole connected segments and purge buffers now; extend to original vector fault IDs for next protocol. Do not infer a .3168 leaderboard score from local DTI.

flags.title: PU prior and mapping propensity are assumptions
flags.finding: pi=.03 and SCAR are fixed registered modelling assumptions, not measured regional fault prevalence; catalogues preferentially record conspicuous features.
flags.action: Do not claim calibrated fault probabilities. Register prior/propensity sensitivity on fresh development folds before testing it.

flags.title: Statistical power and spatial dependence limit significance
flags.finding: Four quadrants alone have limited sign-flip resolution; 16 sub-blocks may be spatially correlated. A Bonferroni-corrected block p-value cannot overcome this limitation.
flags.action: Report both quadrant and block tests; no submission gate without a reproducible current best. Do not tune after observing a negative result.

flags.title: A renamed H19 artifact is not a new model
flags.finding: Main GEMSDOE21 download is byte-identical to historical H19-4. The file-to-.1894 relationship is user-reported; visible account-best alone does not establish file identity.
flags.action: Do not upload again to seek improvement or evade a weekly limit. Keep as a usable format-verified reference.

flags.title: Leaderboard feed automation is prohibited by published Terms
flags.finding: Terms prohibit robots/automatic monitoring; there is no authorized session/API here. .3049 from prompt is older than the inspected .3168 account-best snapshot.
flags.action: Automate permitted official-data/GitHub source health only; explicitly date and stale-mark leaderboard snapshots. Final upload requires the entrant's own registered session.

flags.title: Official PDF and competition page use inconsistent deadline wording
flags.finding: Competition page says Dec 3 2026 23:59 UTC. Rules A.1 has generic 5pm ET and Word/PDF wording, whereas section 3.2 and problem page require a GeoTIFF.
flags.action: Site directs to current platform instructions and a GeoTIFF; do not silently resolve legal deadline eligibility. Entrant should follow organizer clarification if issued.

flags.title: Free external-data availability is not complete validation
flags.finding: Sandbox direct network access to GDR/USGS can fail even while research reader or GitHub-hosted runner reaches them. NHD is retired; GeMS/SGMC coarse maps require exact-version review.
flags.action: Only propose H21-2/3 as conditional until actual product and footprint checks pass; keep H21-4 blocked pending depth/quality matching.

flags.title: GPU model, hidden score and prize eligibility are not verified
flags.finding: CPU-only environment; no hidden labels or authorized competition upload; entrant eligibility/US-based activity/AI disclosure cannot be certified by the agent.
flags.action: Provide code/data lineage and honest CPU test evidence, not an invented training/submission/prize claim.

flags.title: Historical GEMSDOE14 artifact has the wrong origin
flags.finding: The SHA-verified artifact referenced by the inherited registry has correct shape/CRS but origin (500000,4500000), not the supplied (243350,4508550). User score .0020 does not authenticate which file was submitted.
flags.evidence: registry/group-results.json:14GEMSDOE; independent rasterio read of git blob 7c12ed8a4164ce549fc8c3114eb30eb7f898af09
flags.action: Never reuse this artifact as grid-aligned input; preserve source-file identity and require a submission receipt before associating the score with this exact file.

flags.title: First emitter soft-prioritizes NMS rather than strictly excluding non-ridges
flags.status: H21-1 PRESERVED; STRICT SUBSET USED IN SEPARATE EXPLORATORY H21-5, NOT A H21-1 RESCUE
flags.finding: Pre-result emit() boosts ridge ranks but fills the budget from other positive scores. Its evidence mask is data support, not an explicit positive physical-amplitude check; a constant prior score can emit pixels in a toy flat field. This is weaker than the registered strict-NMS/nonzero-evidence wording.
flags.action: Do not overwrite/re-evaluate H21-1. S2 uses strict subset/positive strength under its own pre-registration; its minor integer-quota deviation is separately retained as F24.

flags.title: Three discarded feature hashes differ across hosted preparation
flags.finding: Input-only probe identified exactly the three unused H21-1 orientation SHA fields. All 31 consumed S2 hashes and other manifest metadata match; original full preparation guard still refuses it as an H21-1 replication.
flags.action: Keep exact consumed-byte/mask/support checks. No blanket numeric tolerance or old-result rescue; exact numerical cause of discarded differences remains unproved.

flags.title: All available in-footprint evaluation geography has been scored already
flags.finding: NUM regrouping, strict emission, different seeds or optimizer caps cannot make previously observed quadrants fresh confirmation. The new tiny positive dense effect is an exploratory diagnostic, not independent confirmation.
flags.action: Require genuinely unobserved external/new labels or a separately registered independent geography; no resampling/rebranding of existing quadrants.

flags.title: Binary assets/log archives are inaccessible from this sandbox
flags.finding: Direct official TLS, Azure artifact/log transport, release-assets download and uploads.github.com cache upload failed here. Hosted official retrieval and result publication succeeded. The exact 65,266-byte result was recovered through release metadata and matches the uploaded asset SHA.
flags.action: Use authenticated metadata/hosted receipts; keep arrays outside Git. Empty prepared-cache release is unavailable, not a usable remote cache. Do not relabel this as global source failure.
flags.status: HOSTED EXECUTION / EXACT METADATA RECOVERY VERIFIED

flags.title: NUM alias and unnamed-trace geometry is not perfect geological identity
flags.finding: 3,199 raster components became 149 conservative groups. All 60,988 labels link within one cell, with zero unlinked components, but two linked groups use unnamed source-trace IDs; 87 in-grid-boundary records lack NUM, and four linked NUMs have inconsistent names.
flags.action: Report unnamed and unlinked proxies separately; do not invent physical IDs or resolve aliases from scores. Geometry/labels receive 15px training purges; scoring stays pixel-exact.

flags.title: Rounded first S2 quota exceeds literal maximum by one SW pixel
flags.finding: The first paired SW models each emit 35,716 pixels for 1,428,627 domain cells: 2.50002275%. round() exceeds the literal floor maximum of 35,715 by one pixel. Other folds and total stay below 2.5%. First scores/masks are preserved.
flags.action: Future strict helper uses floor, with a synthetic regression test. Do not recalculate first scores or claim fully literal-budget compliance; the candidate already fails its forecasts, statistical and promotion gates.

flags.title: Event-query obtainability is not catalogue completeness
flags.finding: The official historical rectangular query returned only the first 100 magnitude≥2 earthquakes; 54 lack horizontal error. It is not clipped to the irregular footprint and cannot validate event-plane or 100m surface-trace inference.
flags.action: Audit complete frozen-window coverage, paging, magnitude/network completeness, event type and errors before implementation. Keep H21-8 conditional.
